claims.content: One prompt asks the candidate to describe how social media are used in advertising and to analyse and assess the effectiveness of that form of advertising.

claims.content: Another prompt asks which familiar literary visions of the future touch on similar aspects (e.g. Feed, Little Brother, The Circle, Fahrenheit 451, 1984) and asks for parallels and differences.
